notes: I narrowed the spike from σ=3 to σ=0.3, since E1 (f(-1.2) ordinary) and E5 (f(-1.1) ordinary) prove the spike doesn't extend even ~1 unit from zero, while E2 only confirms it at exactly x=0. The ordinary part remains modeled as deterministic noise since E4 and E6 rule out periodicity and smoothness.
